parsed.explanation: No trans-presentation offence or facility ban is documented, but enforced Article 135 expressly reaches a trans visitor by birth-sex status, was retained with increased severity/scope in the 2022 code, and carries imprisonment plus possible labour camp. Since 2006 the dossier documents state-sponsored torture during investigation, humiliating interrogation, prison violence, psychiatric confinement, and security-service impunity, with LGBTI people among those tortured and high-profile arrests in 2019-2020. There is no anti-discrimination protection, recourse, independent media or civil society to verify frequency. If outed, severity is therefore severe-to-catastrophic under state custody, with thin trans-specific data extrapolated from this enforced criminalisation and abuse record.
